item.title: James Gunn Doesn’t Care About Making Prestige Films - He Wants Movies That Make You Feel Something
item.description: James Gunn has spent his career making movies that live comfortably in the pop culture space, and he’s perfectly fine staying there. While plenty of filmmakers angle for prestige projects and awards recognition, Gunn is wired differently. He wants his movies to connect, to entertain, and to hit audiences on an emotional level first and foremost. item.description: In the early 1990s, MTV built an empire on pushing buttons, and few shows did that more gleefully than Beavis and Butt-Head. item.title: Sean Young Was Originally Cast as Vicki Vale in BATMAN, Here's Why Kim Basinger Replaced Her
item.description: When Batman hit theaters in 1989, it didn’t just redefine the Dark Knight for a new generation. It also rewrote the legacy of one of his most famous love interests. Vicki Vale had existed in DC Comics for decades, but she was usually framed as little more than a narrative device. She was there to admire Batman, worry about Bruce Wayne, and occasionally get kidnapped so the hero could swoop in.
